blurb: Joseph Jacks (JJ) is the founder and managing partner of OSS Capital, the first venture fund exclusively focused on Commercial Open Source Software (COSS) companies. He coined the 'COSS' acronym and has been a leading voice on open source business models, developer-led growth, and the commercial potential of permissively licensed software. On X he posts prolifically about open source strategy, venture investing, and technology market structure. His follower count is in the hundreds of thousands, making him one of the more prominent open-source-focused investors on the platform.
credibility_note: Known as a strong advocate for open source commercialization; his views can trend promotional toward OSS Capital portfolio companies. No major public corrections noted, but his framing of open source business models is explicitly investor-aligned.
